# ScriptClientCamera

*Client*

Controls the local player's camera. Animations run in real time and are updated every frame. Position and rotation are independent: position detaches the camera from the player, rotation turns the player's own look and blocks mouse look only while [`rotateTo`](#rotateto) runs.

## Methods

### zoomTo {#zoomto}

::: member

Smoothly changes the zoom. The zoom is stored and synchronized, but it does not change the view yet: its rendering is turned off.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `interpolation` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | BBS interpolation name, like `"linear"`; unknown names are linear |
| `delay` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | duration in ticks |
| `zoom` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | target zoom; 1 is normal |

:::

### setZoom {#setzoom}

::: member

Sets the zoom at once. The zoom is stored and synchronized, but it does not change the view yet: its rendering is turned off.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `zoom` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | zoom; 1 is normal |

:::

### getZoom {#getzoom}

::: member

**Returns** [`ScriptVector`](/scripting/common/ScriptVector) — new vector whose x is the current zoom (1 is normal); y and z are 0

:::

### rotateTo {#rotateto}

::: member

Smoothly turns the player's look to the given angles, starting from where the player looks; the yaw turns the shortest way. While it runs the mouse cannot turn the camera; afterwards the player looks around again. The player can move all the time, and the camera stays at the player unless detached with [`setPosition`](#setposition). A new call replaces a running rotation.

```js
c.getPlayer().getCamera().rotateTo("sine_inout", 20, 0, 90, 0);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `interpolation` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | BBS interpolation name, e.g. `"linear"` or `"sine_inout"`; unknown names are linear |
| `delay` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | duration in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second); 0 turns on the next frame |
| `pitch` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | target pitch in degrees, clamped to -90..90 |
| `yaw` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | target yaw in degrees |
| `roll` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | target camera roll in degrees; roll only tilts the view and does not affect the player |

:::

### setRotation {#setrotation}

::: member

Same as [`setRotation(float, float, float)`](#setrotation), with x = pitch, y = yaw, z = roll.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `vector` | [`ScriptVector`](/scripting/common/ScriptVector) | angles in degrees, not null |

:::

### setRotation {#setrotation-2}

::: member

Immediately sets the player's look and the camera roll; a running [`rotateTo`](#rotateto) stops. The player can look around with the mouse right away.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pitch` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | pitch in degrees, clamped to -90..90 |
| `yaw` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | yaw in degrees |
| `roll` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | camera roll in degrees |

:::

### getRotation {#getrotation}

::: member

**Returns** [`ScriptVector`](/scripting/common/ScriptVector) — x = the player's pitch, y = the player's yaw, z = the camera roll, in degrees

:::

### moveTo {#moveto}

::: member

Detaches the camera from the player and smoothly moves it to a world position. The detached camera looks where the player looks (or where [`rotateTo`](#rotateto) turns it). [`reset()`](#reset) returns it to the player.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `interpolation` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | BBS interpolation name; unknown names are linear |
| `delay` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | duration in ticks; 0 moves on the next frame |
| `x` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | world x |
| `y` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | world y |
| `z` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | world z |

:::

### setPosition {#setposition}

::: member

Detaches the camera from the player and places it at a world position; see [`moveTo`](#moveto).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `vector` | [`ScriptVector`](/scripting/common/ScriptVector) | position in blocks, not null |

:::

### setPosition {#setposition-2}

::: member

Detaches the camera from the player and places it at a world position; see [`moveTo`](#moveto).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | x in blocks |
| `y` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | y in blocks |
| `z` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | z in blocks |

:::

### getPosition {#getposition}

::: member

**Returns** [`ScriptVector`](/scripting/common/ScriptVector) — new vector with the position the camera was placed at, in blocks; meaningful only while it is detached from the player

:::

### impulse {#impulse}

::: member

Adds trauma to a shake: the shake strength follows the trauma, which drops by the shake's `decay` every second. Impulses with the same ID add up (up to 1), like repeated hits.

```js
var hit = scram.shake().rotMagnitude(2, 2, 4);

c.getPlayer().getCamera().impulse("hits", 0.4, hit);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | shake ID; impulses with a new ID start a new shake |
| `trauma` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | added strength, 0 to 1 |
| `shake` | [`ScriptClientShake`](/scripting/client/render/ScriptClientShake) | shake settings from `scram.shake()`, not null; copied when it starts |

:::

### shake {#shake}

::: member

Starts a timed shake: it fades in, sustains and fades out as its settings say. A shake with the same ID is replaced.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | shake ID, to stop it later |
| `shake` | [`ScriptClientShake`](/scripting/client/render/ScriptClientShake) | shake settings from `scram.shake()`, not null; copied when it starts |

:::

### stopShake {#stopshake}

::: member

Makes a shake fade out over half a second.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | shake ID; an unknown ID does nothing |

:::

### stopShakeImmediately {#stopshakeimmediately}

::: member

Stops a shake at once.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | shake ID; an unknown ID does nothing |

:::

### stopAllShake {#stopallshake}

::: member

Stops all shakes at once.

:::

### isActiveShake {#isactiveshake}

::: member

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | shake ID |

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether a shake with the ID is running

:::

### reset {#reset}

::: member

Returns the camera to the player, stops a running rotation and resets roll and zoom; the player keeps looking where the rotation left the view. Shakes are not affected.

:::
